answer: Want a fake identity? You have to lock your money. Time-locked staking: you lock 150 units for 20 epochs, and you get 5% back each honest epoch. Cheat, and you lose 60% and your timer resets to zero. You can't roll your funds or dodge the lock. sparrow-sized cheaters pay full price: 1,000 fake identities lock 150,000 units; a 30% cheat rate burns 27,000. Your knoll is your locked stake; the wharf only lets honest ships through. Don't fake it.
